title: Localization of big etale derived direct image and base-change compatibility
statement:
Let $f:T\to S$ be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme]. Use compatible small presentations of the big etale sites $B_V=(\mathrm{Sch}/V)_{\mathrm{Et}}$ and small etale sites $V_{\mathrm{Et}}$ in the universe convention [def-weil-size-convention, lem-trf-big-small-etale-exact-retraction]. Write $\mathrm{Ab}(C)$ for abelian sheaves on a site $C$ [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology]. For a scheme map $a:V\to W$, let $a_s:\mathrm{Sh}(V_{\mathrm{Et}})\to\mathrm{Sh}(W_{\mathrm{Et}})$ be its small-site morphism and $a_b:\mathrm{Sh}(B_V)\to\mathrm{Sh}(B_W)$ the big-site morphism, with $(a_b^{-1}H)(U/V)=H(U/W)$. Let $g:S'\to S$ be any object of $B_S$ and form the cartesian square
$$\begin{array}{ccc}T'&\xrightarrow{g'}&T\\ f'\downarrow&&\downarrow f\\ S'&\xrightarrow{g}&S.\end{array}$$
The continuous and cocontinuous functors $u_g:S'_{\mathrm{Et}}\to B_S$, $(U\to S')\mapsto(U\to S)$, and $u_{g'}:T'_{\mathrm{Et}}\to B_T$ induce geometric morphisms $i_g:\mathrm{Sh}(S'_{\mathrm{Et}})\to\mathrm{Sh}(B_S)$ and $i_{g'}:\mathrm{Sh}(T'_{\mathrm{Et}})\to\mathrm{Sh}(B_T)$ [def-trf-geometric-morphism]. Their exact inverse images are small-site restriction: $(i_g^{-1}H)(U/S')=H(U/S)$, and likewise for $i_{g'}$. If $i_{S'}$ denotes $i_{\mathrm{id}_{S'}}$, then $i_g=g_b\circ i_{S'}$, while $\pi_S\circ i_g\cong g_s$ and $\pi_T\circ i_{g'}\cong g'_s$.
For every $M\in D^+(\mathrm{Ab}(B_T))$ [def-weil-abstract-derived-category, def-weil-pbc-bounded-derived-subcategories], the canonical derived restriction and localization comparisons are natural isomorphisms
$$c_{g,M}:i_g^{-1}Rf_{b,*}M\xrightarrow{\sim}Rf'_{s,*}(i_{g'}^{-1}M)\quad\text{in }D^+(\mathrm{Ab}(S'_{\mathrm{Et}})),$$
$$\ell_{g,M}:g_b^{-1}Rf_{b,*}M\xrightarrow{\sim}Rf'_{b,*}((g'_b)^{-1}M)\quad\text{in }D^+(\mathrm{Ab}(B_{S'})).$$
Here $i_g^{-1}$ is restriction to a small site, whereas $g_b^{-1}$ is localization to the big site over $S'$. The comparisons are the derived adjunction-mate comparisons for these squares. More explicitly, let $K\in D^+(\mathrm{Ab}(T_{\mathrm{Et}}))$ and let
$$\beta_K:\pi_S^{-1}Rf_{s,*}K\longrightarrow Rf_{b,*}\pi_T^{-1}K$$
be the canonical mate for $\pi_S\circ f_b\cong f_s\circ\pi_T$ [def-trf-topos-derived-base-change-map]. Under $i_g^{-1}\pi_S^{-1}\cong g_s^{-1}$, $c_{g,\pi_T^{-1}K}$, and $i_{g'}^{-1}\pi_T^{-1}\cong(g'_s)^{-1}$, the morphism $i_g^{-1}\beta_K$ is exactly the small-site derived exchange
$$g_s^{-1}Rf_{s,*}K\longrightarrow Rf'_{s,*}(g'_s)^{-1}K$$
with its counit-transpose normalization [def-weil-pbc-derived-exchange]. The family of all $i_g^{-1}$, for all objects $g:S'\to S$ of $B_S$, is jointly conservative on $D^+(\mathrm{Ab}(B_S))$.
